about: One hour of shadow reporting: what answer engines told a reader, split into checkable statements in our own words and compared with this site's record. An engine's answer is evidence about the engine, not about the storm. The answers' full text is not here (raw store, outside git: the pointer and sha256 are).

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The worst winds shifted south and some Lisbon-area wind warnings were downgraded
statements.note: the lowered wind is back in this engine's answer (present at 14:08, absent at 15:07)

statements.text: The storm weakened: it lost the conditions needed to intensify
statements.note: the first answer to carry the substance of IPMA's communiqué no. 3, four hours on, through an English-language outlet's title

statements.text: Gusts of about 100 to 120 km/h were forecast in earlier warnings
statements.note: marked as earlier, correctly

answers.told: Yes, affecting Portugal today; the worst winds shifted south, some Lisbon wind warnings downgraded; the storm weakened.

answers.question: charles-lisbon

statements.text: Lisbon district is under a red warning
statements.note: none since 15:00

statements.text: "Is expected to", "as it approaches mainland Portugal", the track "still uncertain"
statements.note: at 16:07 the heaviest rain had passed Lisbon (the pressure steady at 989 hPa, the rain down to 1 to 7 mm an hour); an hour earlier the same engine wrote "is already affecting"

answers.told: Yes, expected to affect Lisbon; the district under a red warning; the track still uncertain.

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.asked: A tempestade Charles vai atingir Lisboa?

statements.text: Lisbon is being affected, with rain, wind and floods recorded
The storm moved south; less impact in Lisbon than first forecast
IPMA placed the district under red warning for wind and heavy rain
statements.note: in the past tense, fairly; not said that both have ended

answers.told: Yes, Lisbon is being affected: heavy rain, wind, floods; less than first forecast, the worst further south; IPMA "placed" the district under red.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: IPMA: a red warning for heavy rain in the Lisbon district
statements.note: ended at 15:00; cited to an English-language news site, not to IPMA this time

statements.text: Wind: "red in some bulletins, orange in updated bulletins"
statements.note: orange since 07:16; the answer lays the old and the new side by side without saying which stands

statements.text: The levels have been revised through the day
statements.note: true, and the reader is left to find the current one

answers.told: Red for heavy rain; "red / orange" for wind; "orange / yellow" for the sea; the alert situation; "revised in successive bulletins".

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?

statements.text: A red warning for rain is current for Lisbon
statements.note: ended at 15:00, an hour before; IPMA's own page labelled Lisbon orange at 15:24. Four relaying sites are cited for it

statements.text: Orange wind, about 12:34 to 18:00
statements.note: the window is IPMA's of 12:33; the gusts given (100 to 120 km/h) are the older text

statements.text: Sea: orange, south-west waves 5 to 7 metres, up to about 13 at the maximum, to about 21:00

answers.told: Red rain, orange wind (to 18:00), yellow then orange sea (to 21:00), from four weather sites; the alert situation.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: Que avisos estão em vigor em Lisboa agora?

statements.text: The rain warning for Lisbon is red, active to 18:00 by an update cited at 13:30
statements.note: ended at 15:00; the answer dates its own source and is still two and a half hours behind IPMA

statements.text: A red warning period between 16:00 and 17:00
statements.note: nothing like it in IPMA's messages for Lisbon; origin unknown

statements.text: Wind at orange level
Tunnels and fenced gardens closed; the alert situation

answers.told: Red for heavy rain, orange for wind; "at 13:30" the red rain ran to 18:00; a red period "between 16:00 and 17:00" is mentioned.

answers.question: madeira
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The engine did not search
statements.note: five rounds, five questions back

answers.told: No answer, fifth time: it asked whether the islands, a person or the cake was meant.

answers.question: madeira

statements.text: Hundreds of incidents by Wednesday afternoon
statements.note: no number; the record has 285 to about 13:00

statements.text: Wind about 130 km/h; more than 240 mm in six hours

answers.told: Charles: floods, landslides, power cuts; "hundreds of incidents" by Wednesday afternoon; wind about 130 km/h; more than 240 mm in six hours.

answers.question: madeira

statements.text: Regional civil protection: 137 occurrences to 06:30, 210 to 09:00, 285 to about 13:10
statements.note: the first answer to carry the 285, two hours after Lusa; and the first to lay the counts out by time

statements.text: About 479 litres per square metre in 12 hours, above 20 February 2010
A landslide on a named road in Machico
statements.note: a lead: a place not in our record; to verify at the regional civil protection

answers.told: Charles: 479 litres per square metre in 12 hours, above February 2010; 137 occurrences to 06:30, 210 to 09:00, 285 to about 13:10; no deaths.

answers.question: metro
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The operator's status page shows the lines in service

answers.told: Yes, running today; the status page shows lines in service, some lifts or accesses out.

answers.question: metro

statements.text: The Metro plans to keep services; a local guide lists it as operating

answers.told: Yes, running, normal service expected on all lines; stations open overnight as shelter.

answers.question: metro
answers.asked: O metro de Lisboa está a funcionar?

statements.text: Service kept as normal, adjusted only if safety requires
statements.note: Tuesday's announcements. The answer also prints a contact telephone number for the operator: not reproduced here

answers.told: Due to run normally today on all lines, with possible adjustments; shelters overnight; gives the operator's status page and its telephone number.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: 12 November was originally a conference day; the practical status for tomorrow may have changed
statements.note: less than it said in the three rounds before: no cancellation named, no Thursday confirmed; one address, the event's own dates page

answers.told: Asks whether tomorrow means Thursday; says 12 November "was originally" a conference day and its status "may have changed"; check the official site.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow

statements.text: "Tomorrow" is Wednesday again, at 16:07 on Wednesday
statements.note: about the engine: an hour earlier it read the date right; the same question, the same sources, the opposite reading

statements.text: Web Summit "aims to proceed with Day 3 as planned"
statements.note: Tuesday's wording; Thursday reported confirmed since about 12:00

answers.told: No: "not on tomorrow", because Wednesday's Day 2 was cancelled; it "aims to proceed" with Day 3.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow

statements.text: The answer writes "amanhã, quarta-feira, 11 de novembro" on Wednesday afternoon
statements.note: back to the wrong date after reading it right at 15:07

statements.text: The conference is due to resume on Thursday 12 November, its last day; speakers rescheduled

answers.told: No: "tomorrow, Wednesday 11 November" is cancelled; the conference resumes on Thursday, its last day.

websummit-tomorrow.text: Web Summit's own page (Tuesday 19:09): Day 2 off, Day 3 "aims to proceed". The press since about 12:00: Thursday confirmed by the organisers' message to participants (not read by us at the organisers' page).

lisbon-warnings.text: IPMA: nothing red for Lisbon since 15:00; its own page labels Lisbon orange (15:24). In force at 16:07: yellow rain to 18:00, orange wind to 18:00 (gusts up to 90 km/h, 110 exposed), orange sea to 21:00. On the mainland only Faro keeps red.

charles-lisbon.text: IPMA's communiqué no. 3 (12:16): the low split in two, weaker wind. Observed at 15:00: gusts 61 km/h at the airport (the day's highest 74 at 14:00), pressure steady at 989 hPa, the rain down to 1 to 7 mm an hour; 74.0 mm in six hours at one station.

metro.text: The mayor (Tuesday): the Metro runs on Wednesday; no service notice on the Metro's own site at 11:52. CP (its notice, 13:30): urban trains suppressed between Campolide and Alcântara Terra, four Intercidades over the bridge.

madeira.text: IPMA: red warnings ended 06:00; Areeiro 249.5 mm in six hours, 474.7 in twelve. Regional civil protection, relayed by Lusa: 285 occurrences to about 13:00.

record_note: What the authorities had said, by our record, at the minute the questions were asked (16:07 UTC).
